lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.barrier.en: Breaks through any barrier the weapon touches and partially breaches through armors.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.crushin.en: Increases a weapons damage in exchange of its durability.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.dead_en.en: Ideally reduce the target's Spiritual Health to 0 after 7 hits.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.element.en: Increases damage output of natural effects for each piece of gear equipped.
Decreases damage input of natural effects for each piece of gear equipped.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.energy_.en: Reduces the amount of energy stolen from the wearer.
Drains a small percent of EP from the target.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.enervat.en: Constantly drains the vitality from the wielder and surrounding in exchange for high magical resistance and defense.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.growth..en: Double the amount of Energy the weapon gains.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.holy_co.en: Multiplies the damage against Monster targets.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.holy_we.en: Imbues the weapon with holy damage.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.intangi.en: Completely bypasses enemies' armors and shields.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.letharg.en: Reduces the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_c.en: Allows magic items to hold more magic.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_i.en: Reduces Magic Damage from targets weaker than you, and partially bypasses Magic Barriers of targets.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_p.en: Decreases damage input of magic attacks for each piece of gear equipped.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magic_w.en: Imbues the weapon with magic damage.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.magicul.en: Increases the amount of magicule the wearer absorbs from the environment.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.restora.en: Boost the item's regeneration speed using EP and XP.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.ruinati.en: Stops the item from regenerating and consumes any XP the wielder obtains.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.sealing.en: Seals the items from being enchanted or taken enchantments.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.severan.en: The target will receive damage which cannot be healed by regular means.
Reduces the amount of severance health dealt on the wearer.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.slottin.en: Allows for elemental cores to be inserted.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.soul_ea.en: Imbues the weapon with spiritual damage.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.spiritu.en: Reduces the amount of spiritual damage dealt on the wearer.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.sturdy..en: Increases the weapon's damage, armor's protection and equipments durability, and makes the item invulnerable to environmental damage.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.swift.d.en: Increases the weapon's damage, attack range and attack speed.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.transce.en: Allows the items to gain more engravings with EP.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.tsukumo.en: Makes only the owner of the weapon be able to use its full potential.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.vigor.d.en: Increases the amount of Energy the weapon and its wielder gain.

lang|tensura|enchantment.tensura.vitalit.en: Constantly raises the vitality from the wielder and surrounding while providing high magical resistance and defense.

lang|tensura|gamerule.colossusRespawn.de.en: Respawns the Elemental Colossus when a player who hasn't won against a colossus before reaches the arena in the Labyrinth

lang|tensura|gamerule.demonLordAwaken.de.en: The number of Soul Points needed to be a True Demon Lord

lang|tensura|gamerule.demonLordSeed.desc.en: The amount of EP needed to be a Demon Lord Seed

lang|tensura|gamerule.disableDaemonAutoM.en: Disables daemons players from auto learn Aspectual Magics

lang|tensura|gamerule.disableSpiritualLi.en: Disables the ep limit that applies on spiritual players when entering a physical world

lang|tensura|gamerule.epDeathPenalty.des.en: The percentage of EP that the player will lose when respawning

lang|tensura|gamerule.epGainMultiplier.d.en: The multiplier of EP gain that an entity and its gear would get after defeating a target

lang|tensura|gamerule.epSteal.descriptio.en: Enables certain skills to steal Energy (EP/MP/AP) from Players

lang|tensura|gamerule.forceHarvestFestiv.en: The number of Souls needed to force the player into Harvest Festival for True Demon Lord

lang|tensura|gamerule.hardcoreRace.descr.en: Makes some Races harder to play as

lang|tensura|gamerule.labyrinthDeath.des.en: Allows players to die in the Labyrinth Dimension instead of getting teleported out at 1HP

lang|tensura|gamerule.labyrinthPvp.descr.en: Allows players to pvp in the Labyrinth Dimension

lang|tensura|gamerule.maxApGain.descript.en: Maximum amount of Aura an entity can gain at once from killing a target

lang|tensura|gamerule.maxMpGain.descript.en: Maximum amount of Magicule an entity can gain at once from killing a target

lang|tensura|gamerule.maximumMagicExplos.en: The maximum radius in block that a Magic Explosion can grief the surrounding

lang|tensura|gamerule.moddedEP.descripti.en: How much percentage of default EP value that non-tensura modded mobs can be used for EP gain calculation

lang|tensura|gamerule.mpSkillCost.descri.en: The percentage of MP that the player will lose when gaining a new skill

lang|tensura|gamerule.noUniqueStart.desc.en: Starts with a buff in MP/AP but no Unique Skills

lang|tensura|gamerule.npcGrief.descripti.en: Allows Tensura humanoid NPCs to interact with the environment regardless of the Mob Griefing gamerule

lang|tensura|gamerule.npcWorking.descrip.en: Allows Tensura humanoid NPCs to do their profession/job like farming, chopping trees, fishing, etc.

lang|tensura|gamerule.playerEP.descripti.en: How much percentage of default EP value that fallen players can be used for EP gain calculation

lang|tensura|gamerule.playerManualDodgin.en: Whether if players are allowed to use the keybind-based dodging feature

lang|tensura|gamerule.playerMindControl..en: Enables certain skills to mind control Players

lang|tensura|gamerule.playerNaming.descr.en: Allows players to be named by others

lang|tensura|gamerule.playerSummoning.de.en: Allows players to be summoned by other Players

lang|tensura|gamerule.resetCounterBonusU.en: Gains more Unique skills on resetting based on how many Reset Counters per skill

lang|tensura|gamerule.resetIncompletePen.en: Number of points gets removed from the Reset Counter when a player uses any reset scroll while not meeting the requirement

lang|tensura|gamerule.resetPerSkillLock..en: Number of points of reset counter for each Unique Skill lock for the next reset

lang|tensura|gamerule.skillBeforeRace.de.en: Gains Unique Skills before choosing race

lang|tensura|gamerule.skillGriefing.desc.en: Allows Tensura Ability to grief the surrounding

lang|tensura|gamerule.skillSteal.descrip.en: Enables certain skills to steal Skills from Players instead of copying

lang|tensura|gamerule.spawnerEP.descript.en: How much percentage of default EP value that mobs spawned from Spawners can be used for EP gain calculation

lang|tensura|gamerule.tensuraDisplayName.en: Displays the tensura name instead of minecraft name if the player is named

lang|tensura|gamerule.tensuraEP.descript.en: How much percentage of default EP value that Tensura mobs can be used for EP gain calculation

lang|tensura|gamerule.trulyUnique.descri.en: Removes owned Unique Skills from reincarnation skill list

lang|tensura|gamerule.vanillaEP.descript.en: How much percentage of default EP value that vanilla mobs can be used for EP gain calculation

This ability can not be activated due to the world's gamerules.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.a_rank.en: Get 10000 EP and reach A Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.acquir.en: Smelt or find a Silver Ingot.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.b_rank.en: Get 6000 EP and reach B Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.blesse.en: Have a Greater Spirit or above in every elemental.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.c_rank.en: Get 3000 EP and reach C Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.choo_c.en: Ride an Evil Centipede or Tempest Serpent.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.d_rank.en: Get 1000 EP and reach D Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.deligh.en: Complete a trade and obtain coins.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.elemen.en: Form a contract with any Spirit.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.empowe.en: Kill a monster to increase your Existence Point (EP) for the first time.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.explos.en: Cast a max-level Explosion for the first time!

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.get_bu.en: Pick up a slime with a bucket.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.gold_r.en: Smelt or find a Gold Ingot.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.goodni.en: Slay a Knight Spider and obtain its Carapace.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.grow_a.en: Feed a Slime core to a tamed Slime to grow its size.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.hella_.en: Have a Daemon mob as subordinate.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.high_m.en: Mix some Iron with Magic Ore in a Kiln and acquire a High Magisteel Ingot!

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.higher.en: Awaken as a Demon Lord or Chosen Hero.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.hiss_t.en: Slay a Tempest Serpent and obtain its Scales.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.infamy.en: Achieve Mass Naming by finishing raids or killing human mobs without dying.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.infini.en: Use a weapon that has 3 Elemental cores slotted.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.king_s.en: Get your own Supermassive Slime by growing a slime.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.light_.en: Walk on powdered snow without sinking, using boots made of monster leathers!

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.low_ma.en: Mix some Iron with Magic Ore in a Kiln and acquire a Low Magisteel Ingot!

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.mithri.en: Mix some Silver with a bit of Magic Ore in a Kiln and acquire a Mithril Ingot!

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.monste.en: Tame any monster in any way.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.monstr.en: Eat everything that is edible in Tensura: Reincarnated, even if it's dangerous for you.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.nanoda.en: Obtain the Nanoda disk by having a Charybdis kill an Orc Disaster.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.no_no_.en: Use a Magic Engine to block monster spawn in an area.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.obtain.en: Own and use a Hihi'Irokane Hoe.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.oricha.en: Mix some Gold with a bit of Magic Ore in a Kiln and acquire an Orichalcum Ingot!

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.otherw.en: Explore all Overworld biomes added by Tensura: Reincarnated.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.rainbo.en: Have an Arch Daemon subordinate of each linage.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.ruler_.en: Make a subordinate of each of these races: Direwolf, Goblin, Lizardman, Orc and Slime.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.s_rank.en: Get 400000 EP and reach S Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.sa_ran.en: Get 100000 EP and reach Special-A Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.shell_.en: Slay an Armorsaurus and obtain its Scales and Shell.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.slime_.en: Use a Slime Staff to summon slimes.
Consume a slime in a bucket with skills.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.ss_ran.en: Get 800000 EP and reach Special-S Class.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.unicor.en: Shoot and kill something with a Unicorn horn from a crossbow.

lang|tensura|tensura.advancements.vigila.en: Slay a Giant Ant and obtain its Carapace.

lang|tensura|tensura.message.dwarf.wrong.en: You are not welcomed by the dwarven royal with %s Reputation.

lang|tensura|tensura.message.slime.massi.en: Your slime has became a Supermassive Slime!

lang|tensura|tensura.message.slime.maxsi.en: Your slime has reached its Max Size!

lang|tensura|tensura.message.slime_staff.en: Every slime in 30-block radius is set to Follow.
Every slime in 30-block radius is set to Stay.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.ancient_giant..en: Ancient form of Giants with even more incredible physical capabilities and abilities.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.arch_daemon.de.en: The peak evolutionary stage that can be reached by daemons in the Daemon Realm. Only the most powerful of greater daemons can ascend to this height.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.beast_lord.des.en: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.beastfolk.desc.en: A race that can freely change between their true animal form and a more a human form. They possess immense physical prowess and regenerative capabilities that let them fight without rest.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.daemon_lord.de.en: One of the most powerful evolutionary stages of daemons, achieved only by the most powerful arch daemons.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.death_oni.desc.en: Wicked Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.demon_slime.de.en: The ultimate stage of evolution of Slimes. They evolve to this stage by awakening as a True Demon Lord during the Harvest Festival.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.devil_lord.des.en: The final stage of evolution for daemons. One emerges when a daemon meets all three requirements of a name, material body, and divinity.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_beast.d.en: Beastfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_bird.de.en: Harpy that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_boar.de.en: Orc that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_dragon..en: Dragonewt that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_dwarf.d.en: Dwarf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_elf.des.en: Elf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_fighter.en: Wicked Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_fish.de.en: Merfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_giant.d.en: A godly race born from the earth itself, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_human.d.en: Human that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_oni.des.en: Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_skeleto.en: Wight that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.divine_vampire.en: Vampire that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.dragonewt.desc.en: The evolved form of Lizardmen and descendants of dragons. They have an average lifespan of about two hundred years.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.dwarf.descript.en: A sprite race descended from earth elementals. They possess an immense will and make for fierce albeit rather short soldiers.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.dwarf_saint.de.en: Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.elf.descriptio.en: A sprite race descended from wind elementals. They possess a fierce talent for elemental magic and are more in tune with nature than most.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.elf_saint.desc.en: Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_dw.en: Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_el.en: Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_ho.en: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_hu.en: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_me.en: Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.enlightened_og.en: Ogre that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.ghoul.descript.en: A vampiric thrall brought about by Blood Raise, highly weakened by sunlight.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.giant.descript.en: A race of powerful Majin most notable for their incredible physical capabilities and Magic Resistance.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.goblin.descrip.en: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans. They seem to be descended from the offspring of Dwarves and Oni.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.god_slime.desc.en: The divine stage of evolution of Slimes.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.greater_daemon.en: The daemon race that lesser daemons evolve to when they develop their ego and accumulate enough power.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.harpy.descript.en: A race of winged Majin with capability to cancel out flight spell and are often referred to as the rulers of the skies.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.harpy_queen.de.en: A Queen Species of Harpy with the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.high_orc.descr.en: The evolved form of Orcs. They are smarter than Orcs while preserving the Orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular Orcs.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.hobgoblin.desc.en: The evolved form of male Goblins that is ranked D on average.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.hobgoblin_sain.en: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.human.descript.en: A weak but populous race that relies more on technology and numbers than brute force. Their low magicule count makes skills and magic users a rarity among them, instead favouring battlewill.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.human_saint.de.en: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.kijin.descript.en: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans descended from Fire Elementals. They have an average lifespan of over a thousand years

lang|tensura|tensura.race.lesser_daemon..en: The lowest level of the daemon race. They spontaneously come into existence within the Daemon Realm where they slowly accumulate experience from fighting and being summoned before eventually evolving into greater daemons.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.lizardman.desc.en: A race of scaled people descended from dragons. Their webbed feet give them an advantage in wet terrain.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.merfolk.descri.en: A sprite race descended from water elementals. Their fish-like bodies give them an insurmountable advantage in water.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.merfolk_saint..en: Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.metal_slime.de.en: A slime that has taken in large quantities of Magic Ore. The dissolved ore inside of it provides a strong resistance towards most forms of damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.mystic_oni.des.en: The result of Kijin fully returning to their roots as Elementals, making them Spiritual Lifeforms.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.ogre.descripti.en: A sprite race descended from fire elementals. They possess immense physical capabilities and a strong Japanese lineage.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc.descriptio.en: A race of beastfolk who lost the ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix of the two. Their physical strength is greater than average but pails in comparison to their original strength as beastfolk.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc_disaster.d.en: The evolution of an Orc Lord that is a Demon Lord Seed.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.orc_lord.descr.en: A very rare and powerful member of the Orc race with high intelligence who appears roughly every few centuries.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.slime.descript.en: A Spectral race of monster that lacks intelligence and ambition. They’re usually passive but are incredibly ruthless once provoked.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_beast.d.en: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_bird.de.en: Harpy that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_boar.de.en: Orc that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_oni.des.en: Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.spirit_skeleto.en: Wight that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.true_dragonewt.en: The evolution of Dragonewts and complete Spiritual Lifeforms. They are the second-highest evolutionary stage of Dragonewt known to exist.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire.descri.en: A race of Majin with nearly eternal life. Although they can reproduce, they normally abstain. Hosting overwhelming magical energy and vitality, their flesh never decays.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire_lord.d.en: A vampire among the loftiest levels of power, comparable to a Demon Lord.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.vampire_overco.en: Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.wicked_oni.des.en: A variant of Oni, possessing an essence that leans closer towards that of a Daemon rather than that of a pure Elemental.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.wight.descript.en: A Demi-Spiritual skeletal Undead Monster, highly weakened by sunlight.

lang|tensura|tensura.race.wight_king.des.en: A type of Undead Monster and an evolution of Wights. They possess fearsome power comparable to that of Demon Lord Seeds.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.abnormal_cond.en: Completely negate all abnormal conditions and their effects.
Resist the effects of weaker abnormal conditions or reduce the severity of stronger ones.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.absolute_seve.en: Wield the power to cut through any who stand in your path, whether by coating your strikes or launching slashing projectiles that sever all in their path.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.absorb_and_di.en: Dissolve specific items to instantly consume them.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acid_rain.des.en: Summon an acidic cloud which will corrode any afflicted entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.acid_shell.de.en: Shoots a ball of corrosive acid toward targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aerial_blade..en: Pull in any nearby entities before dealing massive damage by unleashing the power of your spirit.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.agility.descr.en: Greatly enhance the caster's movement speed.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.air_flight.de.en: Use your aura to propel you forward, and hover in air.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.airflow_shut..en: Drain out all the air surrounding the targets and suffocate them.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.all_seeing_ey.en: Go into a 3rd person mode, with your increased POV you gain movement and action buffs as well as an upgrade to Presence Sense.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.analyst.descr.en: Enhance cognitive processing, analyze targets and phenomena, accelerate magic casting and deepen understanding of the laws of the world to optimize all actions.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.analytical_ap.en: Assess the strength of your opponents to gain insight into their overall strength.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_magic_ar.en: Creates a zone around the user that limits all Aspectual and Summoning Magics.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_shock_ar.en: Creates a zone around the user that limits all physical damage taken.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.anti_skill.de.en: Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.antidote.desc.en: Recover a living being from nausea, poison and weakness.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_shield.d.en: Create a shield of condensed aura to block attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_slash.de.en: Condense your aura along your blade and release ranged slash.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.aura_sword.de.en: Coat your weapon in aura enhancing its blows.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sage.descript.en: Increase the speed at which you learn and master skills, magic and arts.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.scale_armor.d.en: Like the lizardmen, move through water and mud with no penalties while receiving a slight defense buff.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.search_enemy..en: Highlight hostile mobs around the caster.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.seeker.descri.en: Accelerate thought processing to extreme levels, mastery over magics and manipulate the fundamental laws governing the world to optimize actions and outcomes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.seer.descript.en: See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.self_regenera.en: Speed up your body’s natural regeneration to increase your survivability.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sense_heat_so.en: Highlights entities that generate heat nearby.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sense_soundwa.en: Empower your ears to precisely locate any nearby entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.severer.descr.en: Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_bind.d.en: If the target is standing in shadows, bind them and deal spiritual damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_motion.en: Melt into the shadows and move unseen by all but the most keen observers.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_strike.en: Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shrink.descri.en: Reduce your size to enhance your evasion but increase your vulnerability

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sleep_mist.de.en: Release a wide area of sleeping mist to paralyze targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sloth.descrip.en: Grind the world to a halt. Put your enemies into a deadly sleep, drain their power and rest to regain any lost vitality. May lethargy take over.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.snake_eye.des.en: Apply various debuff on targets on sight.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sniper.descri.en: Deal damage from afar while using different bullets to get past resistances and ensure a quick kill.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_beam.de.en: Fire a light beam that deals massive damage to undead entities and burns blocks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_flare.d.en: Shoot a shockwave of light energy to give nausea, blindness and slowness to all targets in a wide AOE.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_rain.de.en: Shoot many light projectiles that deal massive damage to undead creatures.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_wave.de.en: Shoot a wave of light energy that blinds and slows hit enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sound_dominat.en: Boosts Sound abilities by a large amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sound_manipul.en: Boosts Sound abilities by a decent amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.space.descrip.en: Form invisible platforms to create footholds midair.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.space_transfo.en: Channel the powers of space to weaken and damage all nearby entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_attac.en: Ignore weaker spatial attacks or reduce the damage from stronger dimensional strikes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_domin.en: Boosts Space abilities by a large amount and deals massive damage by splitting a target with dimensional attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_manip.en: Boosts Space abilities by a decent amount and manipulate space to empower your ranged attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_motio.en: Tear space asunder granting yourself and your allies safe passage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_stora.en: Rift space to create a small pocket dimension to store items.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spearhead.des.en: Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spiritual_att.en: Ignore weaker spiritual attacks or resist stronger ones.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.starved.descr.en: Consume all in your path or have your rampaging subordinates do it. Corrode your enemies, devour their strength, and adding their abilities to your own.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.steel_strengt.en: Strengthen your muscles and gain an increase in damage, toggleable when mastered.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.strength.desc.en: Use magicule to strengthen your muscles.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.strength_aspe.en: Greatly enhance the caster's strength power.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.strengthen_bo.en: Strengthen your body to better protect yourself against attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_basili.en: Summon a Basilisk to temporarily fight for you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_daemon.en: Summon a Daemon from hell to fight for you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_greate.en: Summon your contracted greater elemental spirit to have it purge the world of heretics for you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_hound_.en: Summon a Hound Dog to temporarily fight for you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_medium.en: Summon your contracted elemental spirit to temporarily fight for you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_otherw.en: Summon a human from a different world.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.suppressor.de.en: Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.survivor.desc.en: Endure and outheal anything, resist physical and natural damage and withstand overwhelming odds.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.swipe.descrip.en: Slashing through space in a straight line, displacing entities or teleporting the caster.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.telepathy.des.en: Give orders to tames when looking at them through commands.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.teleport.desc.en: Quickly blink forward in space to a location within view.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thermal_fluct.en: Ignore weaker thermal damage regardless of its type or resist stronger attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thought_accel.en: Increase the speed at which you think to cast magic more quickly as well as to increase your reaction speed.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thought_commu.en: Send commands to nearby allies and become able to instruct them to attack players.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thrower.descr.en: Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder.descr.en: Strike powerful thunder where the caster looks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_breat.en: Release thunder from your mouth to damage foes in front of you.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_lance.en: Strike powerful thunder lances of magic.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_orb.d.en: Call forth a sphere of thunder that strikes any enemy get by.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_rain..en: Call forth a wide area of thunder clouds that strike all enemies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.titanificatio.en: Grow into a towering titan to massively increase your strength, defense, and reach while gaining immunity to magic from weaker foes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.tornado_blade.en: Fire a concentrated sphere of wind toward targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.traveler.desc.en: Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.true_darkness.en: Inflict Blindness on all entities and deal massive spiritual damage.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.tuner.descrip.en: Change your fate survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultra_instinc.en: Enhance your sense to dodge physical impact.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultrasonic_wa.en: Shoot out a screech of sound which damages physical bodies or use echolocation to highlight nearby entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultraspeed_re.en: Boost your bodies healing to nearly impossible levels

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.universal_per.en: Combine all magic, sound and heat sense to detect entities around.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.unpredictabil.en: In the hands of a True Hero, unpredictability reigns supreme. The Hero sees all, becoming able to ignore dodge and even read the movements of their opponent to disable their critical attacks or their dodge avoidance.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.unyielding.de.en: Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.usurper.descr.en: Seize your enemies' power or their summons. Steal their abilities and take control of their skills, draining their strength for your own.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.villain.descr.en: Embody malice and fight on the side of evil. Gain increased power from killing your foes, manipulate your enemies into joining your side and empower your allies.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.violent_break.en: Channel your aura, recklessly enhancing your strength and cleansing you of any negative effects.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.voice_cannon..en: Fire powerful blasts of concentrated sound waves by producing loud vocal sounds atomizing weaker targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.warp_portal.d.en: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water.descrip.en: Call forth or manipulate small amounts of water.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_aspectu.en: Call forth small amounts of water.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_attack_.en: Ignore weaker water-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_blade.d.en: Shoot out a blade of water which flies in a straight line.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_breathi.en: Remove the requirement of air underwater.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_current.en: Manipulate water around you to propel yourself in any direction.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_cutter..en: Fires a concentrated blade to cut your enemies with the power of water.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_cutter_.en: Fire concentrated blades of water toward targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_dominat.en: Boosts Water abilities by a large amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_jail.de.en: Surround targets with flows of water.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_manipul.en: Boosts Water abilities by a decent amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_transfo.en: Channel the powers of water to damage and poison all nearby foes.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.weather_domin.en: Use magicule to manipulate the weather with a higher efficiency.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.weather_manip.en: Use magicule to manipulate the weather.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind.descript.en: Call forth a small gust of wind which can push targets away or the player up.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_attack_r.en: Ignore weaker wind damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_blade.de.en: Fires a concentrated blade of wind which has heavy knockback.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_cutter.d.en: Fire concentrated blades of wind toward targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_dominati.en: Boosts Wind abilities by a large amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_gust.des.en: Release strong currents of winds to create gusts or wind charges toward targets.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_manipula.en: Boosts Wind abilities by a decent amount.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_protecti.en: Call forth flows of wind to coat the caster with speed and protection.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_transfor.en: Channel the powers of wind to paralyze and damage all nearby entities.

lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wrath.descrip.en: Unleash pure rage and use it to get infinitely stronger the longer your anger persists. Beware of the devastating drawback.

lang|tensura|tensura.telepathy.subordina.en: All reached subordinates' behaviour have been set to to Passive.

lang|tensura|tooltip.tensura.iceblade.to.en: A Unique Grade Weapon which once belonged to the Magic Swordsman of Ice.

lang|tensura|tooltip.tensura.long_sword..en: §9Buffed stats when used with both hands.

lang|tensura|tooltip.tensura.marionette_.en: A rare magic item that can turn the user into a Majin with the cost of half their max HP in damage and most of their current Magicule.

lang|tensura|tooltip.tensura.reset_scrol.en: It's not allowed to reset at this state.
It's not allowed to reset %s at the current state.
It's not safe to reset here.
The gamerule [resetIncompletePenalty] is enabled, using this scroll while you haven't completed all Reset Counter requirements will result in the lost of %s reset point(s).
Reset the user's Statistic, Naming status, Awakening status, Spirits, Resistances and Race along with its Intrinsic Skills.
Reset every skill of every type from the user except their Race's Intrinsic Skills.
This scroll will not cover your Unique SKill's MP cost. Be careful, or else you can end up with no Unique Skills.

lang|tensura|tooltip.tensura.wip.en: This feature is a work in progress. It will likely not work as intended and how it currently looks and works may be subject to change in the future.
